Currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Only INR is supported.

SubscriptionStatus.description: Normalised subscription lifecycle. Each gateway's own status is preserved verbatim in `providerStatus`. `cancelled`, `completed`, `expired` and `failed` are terminal.

ChargeStatus.description: Normalised status of a charge (one debit).

ChargeKind.description: `authorization` is the small verification debit taken when the mandate is set up, `recurring` is a debit for a billing cycle, `upfront` is a one-off amount such as a setup fee or add-on.

PaymentMethod.description: `upi` is a UPI Autopay mandate, `card` a card standing instruction, `enach` an eNACH e-mandate on a bank account, `physical_nach` a paper NACH mandate.

SchedulingMode.description: Who decides when each recurring debit happens: `gateway` raises every charge on the plan's schedule, `merchant` means the merchant (this library's scheduler) raises each charge.

EventType.description: Normalised webhook / lifecycle event. `unknown` is a verified event this library does not normalise; inspect `raw`.

Environment.description: `test` is the gateway sandbox, `live` is real money.

CancelMode.description: `immediately` stops now with no further charges; `at_period_end` keeps the current paid period, then stops.

ChangeTiming.description: When a subscription change takes effect: `immediately`, or `at_period_end` (the next cycle boundary).

CheckoutKind.description: How the customer's browser or app completes mandate authorisation; the `kind` of a `CheckoutInstruction`.

count.description: Bill every `count` units: `{ unit: 'month', count: 3 }` is quarterly.

id.description: The gateway's customer id, where one exists.

phone.description: Mobile number; 10 digits or E.164. Adapters format it for their gateway.

id.description: Your own plan id. Used where the gateway lets the merchant choose the id; ignored where the gateway generates one.

amount.description: Amount charged every cycle, in paise.

currency.description: Currency of the plan. Defaults to INR.

scheduling.description: Who raises each charge. Defaults to the gateway's native mode.

maxAmount.description: Ceiling the mandate allows per debit, in paise. Defaults to `amount`. Set it higher to leave room for upgrades or add-ons.

maxCycles.description: Number of cycles after which the plan ends. Omit for open-ended.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value pairs stored with the plan.
